seoDescription: Your space shapes how you live. Petrina Salema helps people transform spaces to redefine the living experience, for themselves or their guests, in Vienna and remotely abroad.

statement.hook: Your space shapes how you live.
statement.support: I help people transform spaces to redefine the living experience, for themselves or their guests.

proof.lede: Successfully completed a Vienna home, now tested on paying guests for five years.
proof.linkLabel: See how a transformation makes hospitality work.

invite.hook: Stop decorating around a life you wouldn't choose.
invite.body: Working on a few homes and hospitality spaces a year. A space takes one to three months, from planning until material sourcing and styling. Available in-person in Vienna, and remotely abroad.
